name: Tangled Time
look: a wild little Celebi with mismatched amber and blue eyes, a vine tangle across its face, red leaf antennae and a white horn, a ragged leafy skirt, one long red-to-gold feather wing and two small blue wings
entry: A Pokémon resembling Celebi, described in an expedition journal about a forest where the trees grew in every direction at once. Lost in time, its eyes see two different ages of the world.
how: Wild: very rare in mangrove swamps and dark forests.
